blocks.text: If you’re a teenager, then you know that life can be pretty hectic. Between school, extracurricular activities, and socializing, there’s always something to do. And sometimes it’s hard to find the time or energy to focus on anything else. That’s where ALBERTA HEALTH SERVICES – YOUTH COUNSELING VEGREVILLE comes in handy.

blocks.text: This confidential service helps teenagers develop a lifestyle free from alcohol, tobacco, other drugs, and gambling abuse issues. Our team of professionals provides guidance and support 24/7/365 through online resources (such as videos), group sessions facilitated by a professional facilitator (both in-person and online), and phone counseling. We also offer customized interventions for specific situations or problems that your teenager may be facing.

centre.about_html:
About Alberta Health Services – Youth Counseling Vegreville

If you’re a teenager, then you know that life can be pretty hectic. Between school, extracurricular activities, and socializing, there’s always something to do. And sometimes it’s hard to find the time or energy to focus on anything else. That’s where ALBERTA HEALTH SERVICES – YOUTH COUNSELING VEGREVILLE comes in handy.

This confidential service helps teenagers develop a lifestyle free from alcohol, tobacco, other drugs, and gambling abuse issues. Our team of professionals provides guidance and support 24/7/365 through online resources (such as videos), group sessions facilitated by a professional facilitator (both in-person and online), and phone counseling. We also offer customized interventions for specific situations or problems that your teenager may be facing.

We believe that every young person has the potential to become successful: If we can help remove some of the roadblocks standing in their way – whether they’re related to addiction or not – then we’ll have done our job well! So if you’re looking for an effective way to help your teen live healthier lives overall, contact us today!

WE shall employ a focused, strength-based, client-centered approach that incorporates evidenced-based therapy methods.

Working together to help children, youth, and families in the communities we care for heal, improve their health, well-being, and prosperity.

We aim to create Wellness Empowered, Culturally Safe, Identity Affirming, and Psychologically Safe Social Communities for everyone.

Hours of Operation: Monday 8:15 am – 4:30 pm Tuesday 8:15 am – 4:30 pm Wednesday 8:15 am – 4:30 pm Thursday 8:15 am – 4:30 pm Friday 8:15 am – 4:30 pm Closed from 12:00 pm – 1:00 pm for lunch. Please call ahead to confirm availability.

Specialties

  • Residential Drug Rehab

Amenities

  • Residential Drug Rehab

Therapies

  • Holistic Therapy
  • Evidence-Based Practices
  • Yoga & Meditation
  • Individual Therapy & Counseling
  • Family Therapy & Counseling
  • Group Therapy & Counseling
  • Nutritional Counseling
  • Art & Nature Therapy
